name: Poster depicting Noah's ark as a calligraphic composition
summary:
Published in Beijing in the 1930s, this lithographic poster shows a calligraphic composition in the form of a ship. The title “Noah’s Ark” is written in Chinese at the top. Above it in the red cartouche is a well-known hadith (saying of the Prophet Muhammad) that likens the Prophet Muhammad’s household (Ahl al-Bayt) to Noah’s ark: whoever takes refuge in it is saved, and whoever is left behind is drowned.
